# Bahdan's Toolbox

> Personal site and free bilingual tools by backend engineer Bahdan Hal: Polish employment comparison, technical SEO and GEO audits, and dated editorial fair-price histories.

## Primary pages

- [About Bahdan Hal](https://bahdanhal.pl/): backend work, infrastructure, AI integrations and contact profiles
- [Toolbox in English](https://bahdanhal.pl/tools): overview of all tools
- [Toolbox in Polish](https://bahdanhal.pl/pl/narzedzia): polska wersja zestawu narzędzi
- [Nginx to Caddy Converter](https://bahdanhal.pl/tools/caddy-transpiler): real-time transpiler converting Nginx server blocks and Apache .htaccess to clean Caddyfiles
- [Konwerter Caddyfile](https://bahdanhal.pl/pl/narzedzia/konwerter-caddyfile): polska wersja konwertera Nginx i Apache do Caddyfile
- [BIMI Studio & SVG Tiny 1.2 PS](https://bahdanhal.pl/tools/bimi-studio): BIMI logo sanitizer, safe-zone validator and live email inbox simulator
- [BIMI Studio PL](https://bahdanhal.pl/pl/narzedzia/bimi-studio): polska wersja konwertera BIMI SVG Tiny 1.2 PS
- [Domain Inspector](https://bahdanhal.pl/tools/domain-inspector): 1-click email security verification for DMARC, BIMI, MTA-STS, TLS-RPT, and SPF
- [Inspektor domen](https://bahdanhal.pl/pl/narzedzia/inspektor-domen): polska wersja inspektora bezpieczeństwa domen
- [Editorial fair-price index](https://ileza.pl/en/): manual judgments about what products are reasonably worth, with dated histories
- [Redakcyjny indeks uczciwych cen](https://ileza.pl/): polska wersja indeksu
- [GEO analyzer](https://bahdanhal.pl/tools/geo-audit): deterministic generative-engine-readiness checks
- [SEO analyzer](https://bahdanhal.pl/tools/seo-audit): technical crawling and indexability checks
- [UoP / UZ / Ud / B2B calculator](https://bahdanhal.pl/tools/poland-employment-calculator): Polish contract take-home comparison

## Data access

- Public read-only MCP endpoint: `https://bahdanhal.pl/mcp`
- MCP tools list exact tracked product configurations and return dated price history.
- No account or API key is required.

## Important limitations

Fair-price values are subjective manual editorial judgments, not statistical samples, scraped listings, algorithmic valuations, completed-sale statistics, or purchasing advice. Visitors may privately submit a public sales-page link as additional context; links are never fetched automatically or published, and seller data or page text is not retained.
